first-flight.title: A Dream of First Flight
first-flight.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
first-flight.notes: 标题：明亮、可记忆的冒险主题；不要悬疑预告片。

tale-peace.title: A Tale of Peace
tale-peace.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
tale-peace.notes: 序章：温柔地交代失忆与世界背景，不先制造悲伤。

tranquil-spring.title: In Tranquil Spring
tranquil-spring.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
tranquil-spring.notes: 庭院：最耐听的日常循环，尾声回到这里形成首尾呼应。

world-door.title: The World At Your Door
world-door.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
world-door.notes: 地图：明确出发与探索感。

market-sea.title: Market on the Sea
market-sea.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
market-sea.notes: 港口：有人生活的海边集市。

morning-frost.title: Morning Frost
morning-frost.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
morning-frost.notes: 森林：清晨清新、低疲劳的探索。

spinning-tavern.title: Spinning Tavern
spinning-tavern.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
spinning-tavern.notes: 工坊节日：轻快、有节奏；试听须拒绝滑稽感过强。

wind-water.title: A Tale of Wind and Water
wind-water.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
wind-water.notes: 云岛：风感、开阔、从容的飞行。

thoughts.title: Thoughts
thoughts.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
thoughts.notes: 书库：安静好奇，给阅读留出空间。

cold-sanctuary.title: Cold Sanctuary
cold-sanctuary.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
cold-sanctuary.notes: 星原：神秘的古迹，不应变成恐怖氛围。

fields.title: A Fight in the Fields
fields.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
fields.notes: 普通战斗：明确的节拍和冒险动力。

out-of-time.title: Out Of Time
out-of-time.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
out-of-time.notes: 早期危机/森林救援：短时紧迫，结束立即回探索。

slave-no-one.title: A Slave To No One
slave-no-one.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
slave-no-one.notes: 中段挑战与终战起势：比普通战斗更有冲突。

showdown.title: Showdown of Misdeeds
showdown.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
showdown.notes: 后段真相与守卫：高压但只在战斗中。

lost-autumn.title: Memories of a Lost Autumn
lost-autumn.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
lost-autumn.notes: 暮铃与身份：亲密、怀念，非持续悲伤。

visions.title: Visions of Freedom
visions.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
visions.notes: 反转：仅短暂用于情绪低点，离开对话恢复区域音乐。

wipe-tears.title: Wipe Away Those Tears
wipe-tears.author: Jonathan Shaw (www.jshaw.co.uk)
wipe-tears.notes: 最终高潮与和解：情绪释放、重新有希望。
